# TASK-089 — Docker Compose

- **Status:** Done — implemented and verified
- **Area:** Gate 7 — administration, governance and infrastructure (2026-09-27)

## Intent

Better Docker Compose: hardening, health checks, optional profiles for Ollama and the PDF publisher; split-image and GPU variants.
